name: Eye眼
description: Screen color temperature inside DBX: an editable 24-hour warmth curve, your own saved presets, sunrise/sunset scheduling, separate weekday and weekend schedules, and 20-20-20 break reminders that briefly dim the screen. It adjusts the display gamma table instead of overlaying a translucent tint, and works per monitor.
releaseNotes: 0.2.0 adds a 24-hour color temperature curve with draggable anchor points, custom presets that keep your own warmth and brightness, sunrise/sunset scheduling computed locally from coordinates, separate weekday and weekend curves, break reminders that briefly dim the screen, and daily screen-time statistics. Schedules from earlier versions are migrated automatically.

zh-CN.name: Eye眼
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 里调屏幕色温：一条可以自己拖的 24 小时曲线、自己存的预设、按日出日落自动切换、工作日与周末分开、20-20-20 休息提醒（到点屏幕会短暂变暗）。直接改显示器的 Gamma 表，不盖半透明遮罩，多块屏可以各调各的。
